newsitem.title: USA: Metal Recovery revises scrap sourcing.
newsitem.headline: Metal Recovery revises scrap sourcing.

text.p: Metal Recovery Technologies Inc, a commercial zinc recycler, said Friday that by mutual agreement it will not complete an agreement under which Essex Trading Co would have served as its exclusive scrap supplier.

"Since first entering into discussions with Essex, Metal Recovery's situation has improved dramatically," said chief executive foficer Michael Lucas. "Although we admire Essex's market knowledge, we now have the resources to exploit the same market without paying financing and commission fees to a third party."
As a result, Lucas said his company will save about $8 to $10 per ton.
